## Exercise 
Create your own small research project

The ISSP 2011 & 2021 surveys contain items on how people explain health problems and perceive
inequality in access to health care. On Moodle you find a codebook and two cleaned datasets
(2011, 2021).

### Step 1: 
Download the data and the codebook from moodle 

### Step 2: 
Open RStudio and load the packages used in Session 2 & 3:

```r
library(haven)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(countrycode)
```

### Step 3: 
Upload the data to R Studio.
You have two different versions of the files: csv & rds

for csv: 
```r
library(readr)
ISSP2011_health_students <- read_csv("...../ISSP2011_health_students.csv")

```

for rds:
```r
ISSP2011_health_students <- readRDS(".../ISSP2011_health_students.rds")
```

### Step 4: 
Now it is your turn! 

- Read the codebook and the R code snippets from weeks 2 and 3

- Formulate a *descriptive research* question using the provided variables
(e.g. Do wom*n and men in Denmark differ in how much they blame poverty for health problems?)

- Prepare your variables: set missing codes to *NA*, check scale direction

- Answer your RQ in R (descriptive statistics and plots, no regressions)

- Prepare max. 3 slides: RQ, variables, findings

*Do not hesitate to ask me if you have any questions or problems*
